q: Can we call our factory coal-free, and what proves it?
title: Calling a factory coal-free
short: Only if no coal or coal-derived fuel is burned on site, and you say what the claim covers. Grid electricity in India is still largely coal-fired, so coal-free on site is not coal-free power. Keep twelve months of fuel invoices showing no coal, pet coke or lignite, and word the claim exactly.

ul: "No coal burned on site since April 2025."
"Process heat from biomass and natural gas."
Avoid "coal-free" alone if you use grid power.
Fuel purchase invoices for the period.
Electricity source documents if you claim renewable power.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.
